WITH pair_averages AS (
  SELECT
    s.transref,
    t.tradekind,
    AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord AS r
    ON s.transref = r.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader AS t
    ON r.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind
),
with_deviation AS (
  SELECT
    transref,
    tradekind,
    avg_optvolrt,
    ABS(avg_optvolrt - (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) FROM sentimentandfundamentals)) AS deviation
  FROM pair_averages
),
with_type_average AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS type_avg_deviation
  FROM with_deviation
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  AVG(avg_optvolrt) AS average_option_volume_ratio,
  AVG(deviation) AS average_deviation,
  AVG(deviation - type_avg_deviation) AS average_excess
FROM with_type_average
WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL
  AND deviation > type_avg_deviation
GROUP BY tradekind;
